summary: Retest after password change ('oneofafind') and appraise.py defensive-default change: 9 backend tests + 9 browser checks executed (15 checks[] entries, some grouping multiple backend test functions), covering all 7 acceptance-matrix criteria plus prior regressions. All passed. No bugs found. /api/appraise (live model) called exactly once.

checks.criterion: Appraise endpoint still works after the appraise.py change
checks.name: test_tscheck_appraise_endpoint.py::test_appraise_with_real_image_returns_valid_appraisal
checks.evidence: POST /api/appraise (real JPEG base64, logged-in session) -> 200 with title/brand/description/condition numeric peak_retail_price/market_average_price/recommended_price present; recommended_price == round(market_average_price*1.15,2); category in the 14 fixed categories. Called exactly once.

checks.name: test_tscheck_appraise_endpoint.py::test_appraise_malformed_body_and_no_session_rejected
checks.evidence: POST /api/appraise with no cookie -> 401; authenticated POST /api/appraise with empty JSON body ({}) -> 422 (missing required item_image)
